up: Return the ChEMBL IDs, molecule names (pref_name), and canonical SMILES for compounds that have bioactivity data against the target 'Chromobox protein homolog 1' in assays performed on Homo sapiens.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.pref_name = 'Chromobox protein homolog 1' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
